title: Physical & Chemical Changes
summary: Some changes just rearrange particles; others make brand-new substances. This unit covers how to tell them apart, the signs of a reaction, rusting, writing formulas and word equations, conservation of mass, combustion and flames, fuels, and fire safety.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Evidence of new substances and energy changes lets us recognise, describe and control chemical change, from cooking a dosa to fighting a fire.

factual: What is the difference between a physical and a chemical change?
What does iron need in order to rust?
What three things does a fire need?
conceptual: How can we use evidence to decide whether a new substance has formed?
Why is mass conserved in every chemical reaction?
debatable: Should India move away from fossil fuels faster, even if it costs more today?
Are fireworks worth the air pollution they cause during festivals?
